title: Time to embrace the technological revolution

ai.summary: Kashmir's horticulture sector faces challenges like climate change and labor shortages, requiring technology-driven solutions for productivity and competitiveness.

facts.claim: Kashmir's horticulture sector is the backbone of the region's rural economy, a major source of livelihood and an important component of its economic identity
facts.quote: Kashmir's horticulture sector is more than an agricultural activity; it is the backbone of the region's rural economy, a major source of livelihood and an important component of its economic identity.

facts.claim: Apple cultivation has shaped the economic and social landscape of the Valley, supporting thousands of farming families, traders, transporters, labourers and businesses associated with the fruit industry
facts.quote: Apple cultivation, in particular, has shaped the economic and social landscape of the Valley, supporting thousands of farming families, traders, transporters, labourers and businesses associated with the fruit industry.

facts.claim: The sector is confronting multiple challenges, including climate change, unpredictable weather, rising input costs, fragmented landholdings, inadequate post-harvest infrastructure, labour shortages and increasing competition from technologically advanced horticultural economies
facts.quote: The sector is confronting multiple challenges, including climate change, unpredictable weather, rising input costs, fragmented landholdings, inadequate post-harvest infrastructure, labour shortages and increasing competition from technologically advanced horticultural economies.

facts.claim: The time has come for Jammu and Kashmir to move beyond conventional agriculture and embrace a technology-driven horticultural revolution
facts.quote: The time has come for Jammu and Kashmir to move beyond conventional agriculture and embrace a technology-driven horticultural revolution.

facts.claim: High-density plantations can begin yielding commercially much earlier than traditional orchards
facts.quote: Unlike traditional orchards, which often take several years to achieve substantial commercial production, high-density plantations can begin yielding commercially much earlier.

facts.claim: AI-based applications can identify plant diseases through photographs, predict pest attacks, monitor tree health and provide recommendations regarding irrigation, fertilisers and spraying schedules
facts.quote: Modern AI-based applications can identify plant diseases through photographs, predict pest attacks, monitor tree health and provide recommendations regarding irrigation, fertilisers and spraying schedules.

facts.claim: Drones equipped with advanced cameras can survey orchards and identify areas affected by disease, water stress or nutritional deficiencies
facts.quote: Drones equipped with advanced cameras can survey orchards and identify areas affected by disease, water stress or nutritional deficiencies.
